opening.argument: The speaker presents BitClub Network as a Bitcoin mining opportunity, then explains how viewers can join: pay a $99 fee and buy a mining pool. She says a pool investment can make money when left running, and that recruiting others brings payment, including a stated 5% commission for the first two mining pools brought in. The pitch pairs those earning routes with a vision of producing 10,000 millionaires; a slide also describes a $200 bitcoin reward for a cycle involving points on both teams. Viewers are directed to a sponsor link and a BitClub URL. Together, these are concrete paid-entry and recruitment-based return claims, not merely a description of mining. The available evidence does not verify the URL or compensation terms, establish participant outcomes, or show that any payments occurred.

citations.quote: You pay a one soft fee of $99 and then you buy a mining pool.
The first one is when you just buy the pool, you invest, you buy the pool, you do some settings and you leave it to run.
The first two mining pools you bring in, Big Club Network will pay you a commission of 5%.
